'''International relations'''
*[[Ethiopian civil conflict (2018–present)|Ethiopian civil conflict]], [[TPLF insurgency in Ethiopia]]
**[[Eritrea–Ethiopia relations]]
***[[Ethiopia]] closes its [[Diplomatic mission|embassy]] in [[Eritrea]] and announces the expulsion of ten Eritrean [[diplomat]]s from the country, after accusing its neighbour of financing the [[Tigray People's Liberation Front]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ethiopia-blasts-tigray-war-a864e8cd442bade4531b8e7609f3216c (AP)]
***[[Eritrea]]'s [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Eritrea)|foreign ministry]] announces that the country will cut off diplomatic ties with [[Ethiopia]] in response. **[[Egypt–Ethiopia relations]]
***A diplomat from [[Egypt]] is told to leave Ethiopia within 48 hours after being declared as ''[[persona non grata]]''. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/explosions-heard-overnight-ethiopias-capital-diplomatic-sources-say-2026-10-01/ (Reuters)]
*The [[European Commission]] stops payments with immediate effect to [[Sierra Leone]], which would have been [[Euro|€]]18 million for 2026, after the nation refused to cooperate with the [[extradition]] of [[Illegal drug trade|drugs trafficker]] [[Jos Leijdekkers]]. *[[2026 RAF Fairford arrests]]
**[[Counter Terrorism Policing|British counter-terrorism police]] arrest a 25-year-old [[British-Iranian]] dual national in [[Westminster]], [[London]], [[England]], on suspicion of preparing [[Terrorism in the United Kingdom|terrorist acts]] linked to the [[RAF Fairford]] investigation. Officers also search two properties in the area. [https://edition.cnn.com/2026/09/30/uk/suspect-police-terrorism-uk-base-fairford-intl-hnk (CNN)]
*[[Sentencing Act 2026]]
**Hundreds of prisoners begin leaving [[List of prisons in the United Kingdom|prison]] in [[England and Wales]] under an early release scheme by the [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] to avoid overcapacity in prisons. More than 4,500 "low-risk" prisoners are expected to be released in the coming weeks. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6evwvdwggrlo (BBC News)] [https://www.firstpost.com/world/uk-frees-hundreds-of-prisoners-including-domestic-abusers-and-thieves-to-ease-crowding-in-jails-14049662.html (''Firstpost'')]
